D.t: Mike Quigley leads by 56.4 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 145,991 votes; a one point swing is about 1,294 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +49.1 and D +63.3. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
